summary: Wait for CUDA pageable-host upload completion before publishing buffers to the nonblocking compute stream.
regressions: A delayed-DMA driver shim reproduced a pending upload before the fix. Thirteen device ABI/compiler/frame/replay tests pass afterward in 7.219 seconds. Both complete 416-stage source bundles were refreshed against the new source in 25.276 seconds.
The prior Metal smoke remains recorded at its exact pre-fix source snapshot; this CUDA-only transfer fix does not alter Metal kernels. No repeat or full matrix was run.
differences: NVIDIA documents that pageable H2D may return after staging but before DMA completes: https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-driver-api/api-sync-behavior.html . The executor now waits for the default-stream transfer after H2D; compute launches remain asynchronous on their ordered stream. No extra per-kernel wait or physics change. Real CUDA execution remains unvalidated.
